settings.tab_content: 11-gauge structural carbon steel tubing. Robotically seam welded for maximum structural integrity under stress.
Static load tested to 1000KG. Drop-tested from 1.5m heights. Exceeds standard home gym requirements.
Seams ultrasonic verified for zero structural porosity. Laser cut holes with precision spacing.
Lifetime warranty on frame structure and welds. 1-year coverage on cables, pulleys, and linear bearings.
